provenance.purpose: show that equal coordinate marginals can coexist with unequal paired joint distributions

source_lineage.locator: FX-007: paired samples (0,0),(1,1) and (0,1),(1,0) have identical coordinate marginals but reversed dependence

comparison.oracle: Both coordinate marginal count distributions are exactly equal; paired joint-pair count distributions differ.
comparison.scope_limit: Separate marginal fit checks cannot establish joint or pathway agreement. This hand-computable synthetic test oracle makes no empirical dependence or clinical claim.

limitations: All rows and values are synthetic and do not estimate or recommend ED parameters.
